flags: Split question: the evidence points to Lazy Boy being a SEPARATE campground: its 14 sites cluster at the west end of the south-shore dirt park road (OSM way 330829491), ~1.5 km from Rocking Chair (2256) and ~1.9 km from Stoll Mountain; CPW lists it as one of the park's 'nine separate campgrounds'.

Eleven Mile's campgrounds (CPW: '326 campsites in nine separate campgrounds ... which includes 14 backcountry sites'): every drive-in one has an entry - Rocky Ridge 2249 (electric + basic loops A-E), North Shore 2250, Stoll Mountain 2251, Cross Creek 2252, Witcher's Cove 2253, Lazy Boy 2254, Howbert Point 2255, Rocking Chair 2256. The only one without an entry is the Backcountry Walk-In area (14 tent sites, 'willing to pack or boat in', 0.5-0.75 mi hike), which is not drive-in RV camping and correctly has none. Aside: Rocky Ridge 2249's pin (38.9349,-105.5008) is ~540 m from its 143-site centroid (38.9396,-105.5022).
Pin 38.9361,-105.5448 is ~160 m from the site centroid (38.9353,-105.5433); fine.
